remedy_principles: Admit endpoint observables only after a typed terminal outcome passes solver-status, event, residual/bracket, final-state finiteness, and physical-invariant checks; contradictory evidence is CONTRACT_VIOLATION, never success.

Preserve both last accepted state and the actual failing evaluation snapshot, including stage, time, raw state/value, and typed reason. Do not clip, floor, recompute, or replace the failure before capture.

Counters state their unit: stored samples, accepted steps, attempted steps, rejected attempts, RHS evaluations including nested RHS work, Jacobian evaluations, actual factorisations, refinement evaluations, and wall time. Unknown is null, never fabricated zero.

Reuse existing result/config modules and delete duplicate maps, message parsing, and misleading fields. No new manifest, readiness document, telemetry system, hash layer, figure, registry, or gate is proposed.

Rust AOT remains the implementation/repeated-run target; SciPy/BDF remains temporary number-of-record; JAX changes are limited to frozen-oracle fail-closed correctness. No proposal changes QKE, public support, or promotion authority.

common_mode_test_risks: NumPy Rodas and JAX Rodas share algorithm/tableau/event assumptions; trajectory parity between them cannot exclude a shared defect.
Rust BDF/Rodas endpoint agreement shares RHS, Jacobian, event, abundance, and calibration code, so it is not independent physics or derivative validation.
Mock/fault-injection tests prove state-machine behavior but not incidence or recoverability on production-shaped trajectories.
Clipping/flooring before assertions can make positivity, Pauli, energy, and Hubble tests pass by construction.
Boolean/message-string tests can pass contradictory states; typed terminal outcome plus residual/bracket/finiteness assertions are required.
len(t), padded JAX arrays, and fabricated zero counters can make work budgets look bounded while measuring samples or unavailable data.
Toy GL6/two-node derivative tests do not validate EXP48/N48 truncation and cancellation behavior.
A normal xfail leaves aggregate pytest green; promotion logic must retain the named blocker independently of suite exit code.
Different NumPy/SciPy patch versions and regenerated context bytes limit exact cross-agent identity even when overlapping examples agree.
Post-failure RHS/observable calls can overwrite or mask the originating solver error; spies must assert zero derived work after failure.
Happy-path event tests do not cover initial zero, nonfinite value, fractional/directionless semantics, subnormal signs, or refinement exhaustion.
Source search or branch names do not prove negative-path execution; deterministic injection and exact reason assertions are required.
